research_question: Can exact action-value grounding and local parse-error isolation correct V37's systematic VRM call errors without changing the model, prompt, or user utterances?

scientific_basis.name: value_agnostic_conversational_semantic_parsing
scientific_basis.design_use: Keep the representation compact while copying and structurally validating spans from the utterance.

scientific_basis.name: symbolic_planning_for_grounded_dialogue
scientific_basis.design_use: Separate LLM reading from symbolic grounding and action selection.

scientific_basis.name: picard_constrained_semantic_parsing
scientific_basis.design_use: Treat structural validity as necessary but insufficient; add schema-aware semantic grounding before executable output.

causal_scope.replay_rule: Development comparison reuses only the already-generated V37 primary reply for every case. No new model inference is allowed before the replay result is frozen.

grounding_rules.anchor_overlap: A supported requested frame is executable only when one ontology anchor for exactly that domain and value overlaps the model-copied evidence span.
grounding_rules.anchor_scope: Negation is evaluated on the clause containing the matched action anchor. Oversized evidence may cross clauses without suppressing a positive anchor in a later clause.
grounding_rules.later_cancellation: A later referential cancellation blocks anchors occurring before the cancellation.
grounding_rules.unsupported: value=unsupported never compiles and needs no lexical anchor.
grounding_rules.no_case_specific_rules: The compiler cannot access case IDs, expected calls, family labels, or benchmark answers.

local_error_isolation.duplicate_target_rule: Duplicate domain/value frames become observable warnings rather than fatal parse errors. Each requested frame is still grounded and compiled independently.
local_error_isolation.warning_cannot_execute: A warning does not grant execution; every accepted requested frame must still pass ontology grounding, scope, allowlist, and domain-conflict checks.

matched_replay_conditions.v37_single_control: Frozen V37 primary parsing and compiler.
matched_replay_conditions.anchor_grounding_only: V37 strict parse validity remains; only target-anchor grounding and anchor-local scope replace the V37 evidence-span guard.
matched_replay_conditions.local_isolation_only: Duplicate targets become warnings, but V37 coarse evidence-span scope remains and no target anchor is required.
matched_replay_conditions.full_v38_candidate: Target-anchor grounding, anchor-local scope, and duplicate-target warning isolation are all enabled.

must_include: conversation proposals containing no physical action
near-miss words that must not trigger an action

decision_rule: Only full_v38_candidate may authorize a fresh holdout. Development replay cannot authorize runtime. Runtime integration requires every frozen fresh-holdout gate in a later committed stage.
